title: Cybersecurity Analyst
description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.  
  
Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

The Cybersecurity Analyst supports, guides, and advises on cybersecurity matters related to dedicated systems, applications, suppliers, and processes based on organization’s operational needs. The role serves as a local interface between Business, Internal IT, Suppliers, and Corporate Cybersecurity, facilitating portfolio and supplier-related cybersecurity activities, IT compliance, and operational cybersecurity execution under the Cybersecurity Management System (CYSMS). The Cybersecurity Analyst collaborates closely with the APJ Cybersecurity Officer (CYSO), Business Area, Cybersecurity Experts (CYSE), and Internal IT teams to ensure effective cybersecurity implementation across APJ region.

**Core Responsibilities**
=========================

* Provide support, guidance, and advice on cybersecurity topics aligned with organization’s needs.
* Act as a local cybersecurity interface for business, IT, and cybersecurity stakeholders.
* Support IT compliance operations and act as a first escalation contact when applicable.
* Assist Cybersecurity Officer in Cybersecurity Asset Protection (CAP), identifying business-critical assets, and local assurance and compliance activities.
* Contribute to implementing cybersecurity directives, instructions, and guidelines under the CYSMS.
* Respond to and follow up on Information Security reports, findings, and required actions.
* Participate in global Cybersecurity / Information Security communities.

**Supplier & Third‑Party Cybersecurity**

* Support supplier and third-party cybersecurity assessments including security questionnaires, evidence collection, and remediation follow-ups.
* Serve as a local cybersecurity contact for procurement and supplier onboarding.
* Support compliance with third-party cybersecurity and data protection requirements.

**Internal IT Collaboration**
-----------------------------

* Collaborate closely with Internal IT teams to drive the implementation of cybersecurity controls.
* Support vulnerability remediation and hardening activities.
* Embed cybersecurity requirements into IT operations and projects.
* Assist in incident and vulnerability handling in coordination with IT & Cybersecurity Officer.
* Ensure cybersecurity requirements are operationalized beyond documentation.

**Audit & Assurance Support**
-----------------------------

* Support internal and external audits such as ISO 27001, customer audits, and regulatory reviews.
* Track and aid in closing cybersecurity findings and improvement actions.
* Support maturity assessments and continuous improvement initiatives within the organization.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

### **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

### **Experience**

* Experience in cybersecurity, information security, IT compliance, or IT operations.
* Exposure to IT systems, applications, infrastructure, or cloud environments.
* Experience working with suppliers or third parties in IT or security contexts.
* Advantageous to have experience supporting assessments, audits, controls, or remediation activities.
* 5+ Years of relevant work experience.
* ### **Cybersecurity Certifications (Preferred but Not Mandatory)**
* ISO/IEC 27001 Foundation or Internal Auditor.
* CompTIA Security+.
* Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP) or equivalent cloud-security certification.
* Third-party/supplier risk or audit-related certifications considered an advantage.

**Skills & Competencies**
-------------------------

* Strong interest and passion for cybersecurity.
* Ability to work effectively at the intersection of business, IT, and security.
* Practical, execution-oriented mindset.
* Strong coordination and communication skills.
* Capability to act as a trusted local contact and escalation point.

title: Fund Servicing Analyst
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

We welcome you to join one of the world's top five most admired and prominent companies. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. Come join us to be the best financial services company in the world which is formed to foster a creative, inclusive work environment that always values employees' personal and professional development.
  
  
As a Fund Servicing Analyst within JPMorganChase, you will play a crucial role in our fund servicing operations. Your primary focus will be on executing routine transactions and collaborating with various teams. You will also apply your knowledge of fund servicing to ensure smooth operations, while also identifying opportunities for process improvements. Your emotional intelligence will help you build strong relationships and influence better outcomes. This role is an excellent opportunity to develop your skills and contribute to our team's success.

* Manage **investor onboarding** and respective contact setup as part of Private Equity fund launches and subsequent fund closes.
* Maintain and update **investor static data**, including bank/wire instructions, contact information and accounting-related data across applicable systems.
* Process requests for **fund notices**, ensuring accurate upload and release to applicable investors within required timelines.

* Identify, proactively communicate and **escalate issues or exceptions** to management in a timely manner.
* Provide **training and process support to new team members**, where applicable, to facilitate effective knowledge transfer.
* Collaborate with global Investor Relations teams and contribute to **client-related, internal and ad hoc projects** as assigned.

**Required qualifications, capabilities and skills**

* Bachelor's degree in **Commerce or a related discipline**.
* Minimum **5 years of relevant experience** in data maintenance, transaction processing or related financial services operations.
* Experience in **client/investor onboarding, AML/KYC operations or investor servicing**.
* Exposure to **Private Equity, Alternative Funds or fund administration operations**.
* Experience working with applications such as **Investran and Data Exchange**.
* Strong **attention to detail and accuracy**, with the ability to operate in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* Excellent **written and verbal communication, problem-solving and stakeholder management skills**, with a professional and proactive approach.
* Strong **teamwork and independent working capabilities**, with the ability to follow established procedures and demonstrate ownership through completion.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

description:

* 2+ years’ experience in Corporate Banking, Credit research or Debt advisory
* Experience in working in any of the following sectors preferable, FIG&/or Banks

* Good understanding of Credit metrics, Covenants, Capital structure, financial statement and ratio analysis
* Impeccable communication and interpersonal relationship skills with the ability to interact with senior professionals and key stakeholders
* Strong logical, analytical skills and a systematic problem-solving approach
* Ability to proficiently use Microsoft Office Applications – Power Point and Excel
* Strong time management skills and ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines
* Attention to detail and ability to ensure high quality of deliverables
* Ability to interact with integrity and a high level of professionalism with all levels of team members and management
* Results driven, accountable and ability to work with multiple priorities in a fast-paced and results-driven environment

**Job Expectations:**

* Work as an individual contributor on various work streams that form key components of Wells Fargo’s Corporate Banking debt financing, F/X and/or Rates products, across sectors
* Assist in preparing Credit memos, credit reports or annual reviews for corporate clients including support in drafting company/borrower overviews, business description, industry overviews, corporate actions and in performing historical financial analysis and industry or peer analysis
* Work on publishing Quarterly or annual earnings summaries for target portfolio companies and in tracking credit rating reports or equity reports
* Prepare market or sector updates, sector newsletters to keep a track of key market developments
* Work on borrower rating, capital structure and covenant analysis
* Monitor and track covenant compliance
* Support in drafting non-borrower reports, Annual credit reviews or CAC Memos

9 Oct 2026

There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Associate Cloud Operations Analyst
description:
**About Us:**

CDK Global is a leading provider of cloud-based software to dealerships and Original Equipment Manufacturers (“OEMs”) across automotive and related industries. The Company’s cloud-based, software as a service (“SaaS”) platform enables dealerships to manage their end-to-end business operations including the acquisition, sale, financing, insuring, repair, and maintenance of vehicles. By automating and streamlining critical workflows, the integrated platform of modern solutions enables dealers to sell and service more vehicles by creating simple and convenient experiences for customers and improves their financial and operational performance.
  
  
**Position Summary:**

We are seeking a highly skilled Public Cloud Operations Support Specialist to join our team. This role is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of our public cloud infrastructure, ensuring optimal performance, availability, and security of cloud resources. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with leading public cloud platforms (AWS and Azure), strong troubleshooting skills, and the ability to work with cross-functional teams to support business operations.

  

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Cloud Infrastructure Management and Support:**

* Monitor and manage the health and performance of cloud-based resources (e.g., virtual machines, storage, networks, databases).
* Provide technical support for issues related to public cloud platforms, including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
* Ensure cloud resources are properly configured and optimized for performance, cost, and security.
* Participate in On-call rotations

**Incident Management and Troubleshooting:**

* Respond to and resolve incidents and service requests related to public cloud environments.
* Investigate and diagnose cloud service issues, escalating to senior engineers or cloud providers when needed.
* Ensure proper root cause analysis and implement long-term fixes for recurring issues.

**Deployment and Automation:**

* Assist in deployment and management of cloud-based applications and services using CI/CD pipelines
* Help automate repetitive tasks using cloud automation tools (Terraform and Ansible).

**Collaboration and Documentation:**

* Work closely with development and engineering teams to troubleshoot issues.
* Provide technical support and training to internal teams on cloud best practices and new services.
* Document FAQ, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and troubleshooting guides.

**Performance Monitoring and Optimization:** .

* Act on alerts and tune the environment.
* Optimize cloud usage and ensure resources are right-sized properly.

**Security and Compliance:**

* Monitor cloud environments for security vulnerabilities and compliance issues, utilizing AWS security tools like Guard Duty and AWS Shield.
* Assist in maintaining cloud security standards in alignment with internal policies and industry best practices.
Support audits and assist with ensuring compliance with regulations  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Proven experience with public cloud platforms (AWS / Azure).
* Solid understanding of cloud networking, compute, storage, and security services.
* Extensive experience with AWS Cloud Platform and its services.
* Familiar with ci/cd tools such as Harness, bamboo or github actions.
* Experience with Infrastructure as code such as terraform and Ansible.
* Understanding of cloud security concepts like IAM (Identity and Access Management), VPC (Virtual Private Cloud), encryption, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
* Previous experience providing operational support to both AWS and Azure environments.
* Ability to work independently and within a team environment.
* Strong communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to stay updated with emerging cloud technologies and integrate them into operations.

title: Senior Analyst, IT Operations
description:

Ensemble Health Partners - The single solution for a frictionless revenue cycle with the purpose of redefining the possible in healthcare by empowering people to be the difference. Our India Office is an extension of Ensemble’s team and culture designed to augment and enhance our talent and skill base in Revenue Cycle Management in addition to our long-standing presence in technology. Leveraging our platform of services, technology, business intelligence and analytics, our teams are creating and maintaining innovative products and systems to help our revenue cycle operators achieve the most efficient, ideal outcomes for our clients. Our teams are certified in revenue cycle best practices and are supporting end-to-end RCM operations. We are at the forefront of innovation using cutting-edge technology to drive meaningful impact in the Revenue Cycle Management landscape. As a leading player in the industry, we offer an environment that fosters growth, creativity, and collaboration, where your expertise will be valued, and your contributions will make a difference.

**The Opportunity:**

The Senior Analyst, IT Operations monitors, maintains, and supports enterprise technology infrastructure, critical business systems, and production service environments. The role leads operational response activities for complex incidents, service degradations, outages, maintenance events, capacity concerns, and recovery scenarios while ensuring adherence to established service management, security, compliance, and operational governance standards.

This position performs advanced troubleshooting, coordinates cross-functional response efforts, supports root-cause investigations, executes approved changes, and contributes to operational excellence initiatives. The role utilizes monitoring platforms, automation tools, operational procedures, and ITIL-based practices to maintain service stability and improve operational effectiveness.

The Senior Analyst also provides technical guidance to less experienced team members, supports operational readiness activities, and contributes to documentation, process improvement, and service optimization efforts.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**Service Monitoring & Operations**
-----------------------------------

* Monitor enterprise infrastructure, platforms, systems, servers, applications, and services.
* Identify, assess, prioritize, and respond to operational events and alerts.
* Perform ongoing health checks, performance monitoring, capacity reviews, and operational validation activities.
* Maintain service availability and reliability across production environments.

**Incident & Problem Management**
---------------------------------

* Lead resolution of escalated Tier 2 and Tier 3 incidents.
* Coordinate technical response activities across infrastructure, network, cloud, application, and security teams.
* Facilitate incident triage, impact assessment, escalation management, and service restoration.
* Participate in root cause analysis and problem management activities.
* Support development and implementation of preventative solutions.

**Change & Release Support**
----------------------------

* Execute approved changes in accordance with IT service management processes.
* Participate in maintenance activities, patching, upgrades, and production deployments.
* Validate operational readiness and implementation outcomes.
* Identify operational risks and recommend mitigation strategies.

**Operational Continuity & Recovery**
-------------------------------------

* Coordinate recovery activities during technology incidents and service interruptions.
* Support disaster recovery, business continuity, and failover testing activities.
* Execute operational recovery procedures and validation activities.
* Maintain readiness for critical service restoration events.

**Process Improvement & Automation**
------------------------------------

* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reliability, and service quality.
* Support automation initiatives that reduce manual operational effort.
* Contribute to operational process redesign and service optimization projects.
* Recommend monitoring, alerting, and workflow enhancements.

**Documentation & Governance**
------------------------------

* Maintain operational procedures, runbooks, system documentation, and support materials.
* Document incidents, service interruptions, recovery activities, and changes.
* Support audit, compliance, and governance activities.
* Ensure adherence to organizational operating standards and technology policies.

**Performance & Reporting**
---------------------------

* Produce operational metrics, service reports, and trend analyses.
* Monitor SLA, availability, incident, change, and operational performance indicators.
* Support leadership reporting and performance reviews.
* Identify actionable recommendations based on operational data.

**Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing**
--------------------------------------------

* Serve as a senior escalation resource for operational support teams.
* Provide technical coaching and guidance to junior analysts.
* Share operational knowledge and best practices.
* Support onboarding and development of team members.

**Scope & Complexity**
======================

* Independently manages complex operational issues and service events.
* Coordinates response activities across multiple technical disciplines.
* Supports mission-critical systems and business services.
* Exercises judgment within established operational and governance frameworks.
* Frequently addresses ambiguous technical problems requiring analysis and prioritization.
* Influences operational decisions through technical expertise and service impact assessment.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 4+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure operations, systems administration, NOC operations, cloud operations, or technology support environments.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments.
* Experience with incident, problem, and change management processes.
* Experience using enterprise monitoring and operational management tools.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
============================

* ITIL Foundation or related service management certification.
* Microsoft, AWS, Azure, Cisco, VMware, Linux, or platform-specific certifications.
* Experience supporting cloud platforms and hybrid infrastructure environments.
* Experience with automation, scripting, monitoring platforms, and operational analytics.

title: Information Security Consultant

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

**Your day at NTT DATA**  
The Risk Analyst is a seasoned subject matter expert, responsible for assessing and managing risks to ensure the security, integrity, and resilience of the organization's operations and services.  
  
This role involves identifying potential threats, analyzing vulnerabilities, and providing recommendations to mitigate risks.  
  
Through proactive risk assessment and collaboration with cross-functional teams, this role contributes to the organization's efforts to maintain a secure and compliant environment.

**Key responsibilities:**

* Analyzes risk to business activities and operations.
* Identifies areas of potential loss or damage for current and proposed business and financial operations, processes, structures and cyber-risk exposure and quantifies impact
* Implements and evaluates compliance with business and cyber risk-reduction policies, processes and standards.
* May participate in the development and maintenance of disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Supports organizational processes and programs for mitigation of financial risk, including administration of insurance.
* May support and administer security and health/safety programs in addition to risk management activities.
* Performs any other related task as required by management.

**To thrive in this role, you need to have:**

* Strong understanding of risk assessment methodologies, global regulations, and compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in data analysis tools and techniques for identifying trends, patterns, and potential risks.
* Excellent analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills to convey complex risk concepts to a global audience.
* Cultural sensitivity and adaptability to work across different regions and time zones
* Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional and global teams.

**Academic qualifications and certifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Business, Information Security, Risk Management or related field.
* Relevant certifications such as CISM, CRISC, CISSP, CIPP preferred.

**Required experience:**

* Seasoned years of experience as a Risk Analyst, preferably in a global organization with diverse operations.

**Workplace type****:**

Hybrid Working

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune

Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through

responsible innovation. We are one of the world’s leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with

unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and

application services. Our consulting and industry solutions help organizations and society move

confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more

than 70 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as

established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each

description:
**About the Job:**


The Integration Platform Engineer designs, builds, and operates the integrations that move data and events between the enterprise systems the business runs on. This is a hands\-on engineering role covering application integration, event streaming, data integration, managed file transfer, and business\-to\-business exchange.


The integration estate is deliberately heterogeneous. It spans modern cloud\-native integration alongside established enterprise middleware, and includes MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services, TIBCO, Informatica Cloud, Solace, Axway, Kong, Apache Kafka, and native AWS services. Engineers in this role are expected to build fluently on the right tool for each pattern, and to help consolidate and modernise the estate over time.


The platform is run both as an internal product and as a managed service, across Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Integration Design and Development**

* Design and build integrations using established patterns for request\-reply, publish\-subscribe, orchestration, choreography, and batch processing.
* Develop interfaces on the platforms in scope, including MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services, TIBCO, and Informatica Cloud.
* Implement data mapping, transformation, enrichment, validation, and error handling with clear reprocessing paths.
* Build reusable connectors, templates, and integration assets that reduce delivery effort for future work.

**Event\-Driven and Streaming Integration**

* Build event\-driven integrations using Apache Kafka, Solace, and other cloud\-native eventing services.
* Design topics, schemas, and contracts with appropriate schema governance and versioning.
* Implement patterns for ordering, idempotency, replay, and dead\-letter handling.

**Data, File, and B2B Integration**

* Build data integration pipelines covering extract, transform, and load, change data capture, and bulk movement using Informatica Cloud and equivalent tooling.
* Operate and develop managed file transfer and secure file exchange using Axway and SFTP\-based patterns.
* Implement and support business\-to\-business and EDI exchanges with external trading partners.

**Enterprise Systems Connectivity**

* Integrate core enterprise platforms including SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and BTP or Cloud Platform Integration using IDocs, BAPIs, and modern APIs.
* Integrate commercial and medical systems including Salesforce and Veeva.
* Integrate manufacturing, laboratory, and quality systems including MES, LIMS, and SCADA environments.

**Operations, Security, and Support**

* Own the availability, throughput, latency, and capacity of the interfaces in scope.
* Instrument integrations for observability using Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk, Cribl, and Observe.
* Contribute to incident response, root\-cause analysis, problem management, and corrective actions.
* Implement secure connectivity using OAuth2, mutual TLS, certificate\-based authentication, and secure file transfer protocols.
* Manage secrets and certificates through HashiCorp Vault, CyberArk, and cloud\-native key services.

**Technical Craft and Engineering Practices**

* Manage integration artefacts as code in Git, with automated build, test, and deployment through GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Build automated unit, contract, and end\-to\-end tests, including negative and volume scenarios.
* Use AI\-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot and Claude Code to accelerate mapping, test generation, and documentation, applying appropriate review and technical judgement.

**Collaboration and Ways of Working**

* Work within an agile product team with a shared backlog and defined customers.
* Partner with business analysts and functional teams to translate process requirements into robust interface designs.
* Work with API, data, cloud, and application teams to agree contracts and ownership boundaries.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Demonstrated capability in integration or middleware engineering, typically gained across five to eight years of professional experience.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with at least one enterprise integration or iPaaS platform, such as MuleSoft, Azure Integration Services, TIBCO, Informatica Cloud, or Boomi.
* Strong command of integration patterns, message design, transformation, and error\-handling strategies.
* Experience with event\-driven integration using Kafka, Solace, or a comparable platform.
* Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language such as Python, JavaScript, or Java.
* Experience integrating at least one major enterprise system such as SAP, Salesforce, Veeva, Workday, or ServiceNow.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across network, message, transformation, and endpoint layers.

**Preferred**

* Resilience and composure when diagnosing production integration failures

description:
*EPAM is a leading global provider of digital platform engineering and development services. We are committed to having a positive impact on our customers, our employees, and our communities. We're looking for a **Senior/Lead Security Engineer** to lead HIPAA and FedRAMP/NIST 800\-53 compliance efforts, converting regulatory mandates into actionable engineering tasks, supporting third\-party audits, and coordinating across security, privacy, and legal functions.

**Responsibilities**

* Convert HIPAA gap analyses, NIST 800\-53 privacy controls, and audit findings into scoped Azure DevOps Features/Stories/Tasks with defined acceptance criteria, effort estimates, and an assigned owner
* Keep the backlog organized across active compliance features, covering access control, data classification, log scrubbing, audit logging, data retention \& deletion, and data access restrictions

* 6\-15 years of overall IT experience
* Background in security/privacy compliance, GRC, or compliance engineering, supporting HIPAA and/or FedRAMP/NIST 800\-53 programs
* Understanding of HIPAA Security \& Privacy Rules, including administrative/physical/technical safeguards, BAAs, breach notification, and minimum necessary standards, along with NIST 800\-53 control families such as AC, AU, SI, and PM

title: Team Leader, ICE Climate Operations
description:
Job Description:
**Job Purpose**


ICE Climate Operations supports ICE's Climate Risk Data business, covering physical climate risk, transition risk, nature\-related risk, and avoided emissions across public and private companies, sovereigns, and structured finance assets such as mortgage\-backed and municipal securities. The Physical Risk team runs the geospatial research and quality assurance function behind this coverage, identifying and validating corporate and sovereign asset locations against wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme\-temperature exposure for ICE's global geospatial risk platform.

  

Lead the operational delivery and continuous improvement of Physical Risk data projects within ICE Climate Operations. The role manages and develops a team of analysts responsible for asset\-location research, geospatial validation, structured quality assurance, and project delivery. It combines people leadership with hands\-on oversight of complex research and QA, ensuring data is accurate, complete, traceable, and delivered in line with product and client priorities.

  

The team leader is the primary operational contact for Physical Risk workstreams and coordinates closely with Product, R\&D, Engineering, Analytics, and Data Quality teams. The role is expected to translate evolving requirements into clear work plans, maintain visibility of progress and risks, and build the team's ability to support product improvements and respond to data\-related queries with increasing independence.

 **Responsibilities**

* Team leadership and delivery management
	+ Lead, coach, and develop a team of associates and senior associates, setting clear expectations for delivery, quality, accountability, and professional growth.
	+ Convert business and project priorities into practical work plans, allocate resources across concurrent workstreams, and adjust assignments as priorities change.
	+ Monitor milestones, productivity, quality, and turnaround times; identify delivery risks early and implement recovery actions.
	+ Conduct regular one\-to\-one discussions, goal setting, performance reviews, and development planning; support recruitment, onboarding, and succession readiness.
	+ Act as the first point of escalation for operational blockers, quality concerns, scope ambiguity, and resourcing conflicts.
* Physical risk project and product support
	+ Lead operational support for Physical Risk initiatives, including industrial and mine location QA, high\-materiality asset review, corporate mapping, location weighting, and damage\-function research across corporate, sovereign, and private\-company asset classes.
	+ Coordinate delivery with Product and R\&D stakeholders, clarify objectives and acceptance criteria, maintain project status and dependencies, and ensure outputs are usable for downstream product or model development.
	+ Keep the team focused on work that improves the quality and coverage of Physical Risk products, including continuous QA of critical asset data and on\-demand QA or updates for client\-driven requirements spanning wildfire, flood, hurricane, and extreme\-temperature exposure.
	+ Build sufficient product and methodology knowledge within the team to support data samples, stakeholder queries, and issue investigation with reduced dependency on Product teams.
* Research, geospatial data, and quality assurance
	+ Oversee research to identify, classify, map, and validate corporate asset locations, ownership relationships, operational status, facility type, coordinates, and materiality indicators.
	+ Ensure consistent use of authoritative internal data, third\-party datasets, company disclosures, mapping platforms, satellite imagery, and documented public sources.
	+ Review complex or high\-risk discrepancies, confirm source traceability, approve final outputs, and direct root\-cause analysis and corrective actions.
	+ Oversee QA controls for completeness, coordinate accuracy, classification, duplication, status, source evidence, and conformity with approved methodologies and due\-diligence standards.
	+ Ensure project outputs are documented, reproducible, and ready for ingestion, analytics, model research, or client delivery as applicable.
* Data, reporting, and operational governance
	+ Use SQL and BigQuery to retrieve, join, analyze, and validate entity and location datasets; use advanced Excel and reporting tools to manage and communicate delivery performance.
	+ Maintain concise dashboards and status reporting covering scope, milestones, quality, throughput, risks, dependencies, and decisions required.
	+ Establish clear operating procedures, research playbooks, source hierarchies, QA checklists, and hand\-off criteria; keep documentation current as requirements evolve.
	+ Support audits, internal reviews, release validation, production issue analysis, and governance activities relevant to Physical Risk data operations.
* Process improvement, automation, and capability building
	+ Identify recurring data and workflow issues and implement scalable improvements that reduce manual effort, rework, and turnaround time without weakening control quality.
	+ Promote responsible use of AI\-assisted research, automated validation, and smart workflows, with human verification and clear evidence retained for material decisions.
	+ Develop team capability in Physical Risk methodology, corporate structures and identifiers, GIS and mapping, asset materiality, SQL/BigQuery, QA, and relevant internal platforms.
	+ Create a collaborative learning environment through structured training, calibration sessions, knowledge sharing, and review of complex cases.

 **Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Science or Planning, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in data operations related to geospatial or location data, GIS research, including experience leading people or project delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage priorities, resources, quality, and stakeholder expectations in a data\-intensive operational environment.
* Working knowledge of corporate entity structures, asset\-location data, geospatial concepts, mapping tools, and research\-based verification.
* Proficiency in SQL, Python, and advanced Excel; practical experience querying and analyzing large datasets. Experience with BigQuery is strongly preferred.
* Strong analytical judgment, attention to detail, documentation discipline, and ability to resolve ambiguous or conflicting evidence.
* Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to present status, risks, recommendations, and decisions to technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

 **Preferred Knowledge and Experience**

* Experience supporting Physical Risk, climate risk, catastrophe modelling, asset\-level analytics, or commercial geospatial data products.

**Job Description\***


The IAM Analyst (Mainframe Provisioning and Security) is responsible for administering and governing user, privileged, service, and technical identities across the mainframe environment, including RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, and related security domains. The role ensures timely, accurate, and risk\-aligned access provisioning, de\-provisioning, role maintenance, and entitlement administration in accordance with enterprise IAM policies, segregation of duties, and regulatory requirements.


This role partners with Lines of Business, account owners, and infrastructure teams to deliver secure access lifecycle management for critical mainframe resources. It also drives process modernization through automation, JCL and scripting, AI\-assisted operational analysis, control monitoring, and continuous improvement to reduce manual effort, strengthen compliance, and improve service quality and turnaround time.


**Responsibilities\***


* Administer and govern mainframe identities and access across RACF, z/OS, z/VM, OMVS, datasets, groups, resource classes, started tasks, and privileged accounts, ensuring least privilege and policy compliance.
* Perform end\-to\-end access provisioning, modification, and de\-provisioning for user, functional, service, and robotic IDs, with strong validation of approvals, entitlements, and segregation\-of\-duties requirements.
* Manage access for sensitive mainframe resources including dataset profiles, generic profiles, groups, OMVS segments, USS access, surrogate access, and command/resource controls.
* Handle escalations, exception requests, urgent access restorations, and complex provisioning scenarios across multiple LPARs and environments while maintaining control evidence and operational discipline.
* Drive process improvement and automation using JCL, REXX, Shell, Python, PowerShell, or equivalent scripting where applicable, reducing manual processing and improving control consistency.
* Develop and maintain operational scripts, batch workflows, and JCL\-based utilities for bulk updates, reconciliation, reporting, evidence collection, and controlled remediation activities.
* Ensure secure administration of privileged, emergency, and non\-human accounts by applying strong controls for ownership, monitoring, authentication, and decommissioning.
